data.name: Ambresh
data.gender_notes: Ambresh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ambresh is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two roots: ‘Amba’ meaning immortal or invincible and ‘Resh’ meaning ruler or king. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture, signifying a strong, enduring, and powerful individual. The name Ambresh carries the meaning “Immortal, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ambresh usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine protection and unwavering courage.
data.etymology: Ambresh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Invincible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambresh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

historical_references.reference: Ambarish was a legendary king of the Southern Indian kingdom of Mysore, who ruled during the 12th century. He is most famous for leading a successful rebellion against the Chalukya Emperor, Jayasimha II, and establishing the Wodeyar dynasty.
historical_references.context: medieval Indian history, establishment of Wodeyar dynasty

historical_references.reference: Ambarish is also a popular name in Hindu mythology for the monkey king Sugriva from the epic Ramayana. He was a loyal friend and ally of Lord Rama and helped him in his quest to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana.
historical_references.context: Hindu mythology, character from the epic Ramayana
